Region 6 - Skeena

This table refers to fishing for salmon only. For information on other species please refer to the BC Freshwater Fishing Regulations Synopsis.

Unless otherwise stated in the table below, the daily limit for all waters in Region 6 is zero (0).

Note:

  • All retained chinook, sockeye, pink, coho, and chum must measure 30 cm or more from tip of nose to tail fork.
  • An "adult chinook" in Region 6 (other than Fraser River Watershed) is defined as being over 65 cm measured from the tip of the nose to tail fork.
  • An adult coho salmon in Region 6 is defined as being greater than 50 cm measured from the tip of the nose to the fork in the tail (fork length). "Jack" coho salmon is defined as being a coho between 30-50 cm fork length.
  • No fishing is allowed within 100 meters of any government facility operated for counting, passing or rearing fish.
